[Character A: Trainer — late 30s, shaved head, grey hoodie, a healed cut through the left eyebrow]
[Character B: Member — early 40s, damp dark hair pulled back, navy training t-shirt, taped left wrist]

Master intent: a 10-second exchange at the edge of the rubber floor after the last set, under one hard overhead lamp.

Shot 1 (0-3s). Two-shot, eye level, 35mm. Character B sits on the bench, elbows on knees; Character A stands one step back. Static frame.
Shot 2 (3-6s). Profile close-up on Character B. She wipes her palm on her thigh, then looks up.
[Character B, low even voice]: "One more?"
Shot 3 (6-10s). Reverse, close-up on Character A. He taps the bench twice with two fingers.
Immediately, [Character A, dry unhurried voice]: "One more."

Camera. Locked frames, no movement except the tap. 35mm and 85mm.
Lighting. One hard overhead lamp, no fill, hard shadows under the brows.
Audio. Rack of plates settling, a fan somewhere behind them, no music.

Negative field. blurry, distorted hands, extra fingers, melted face, subtitles, dialogue overlap.
